auth.profileMissing: Your account exists but there is no profile row (often after an incomplete first signup). In Supabase: Authentication → delete this user and sign up again; or add the row manually in the "profiles" table.
auth.emailNotConfirmed: Your session is not active yet. Open the confirmation link in the email from Supabase, then try signing in again.
auth.invalidSupabaseKey: The Supabase API key does not match your project. In the Supabase dashboard: Project Settings → API, copy the anon public key (long JWT), put it in ExpenseApp/.env as EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=… and set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL to your project URL. Restart npm run dev.
auth.requestTimeout: Sign-in took too long (network or server). Reload the page and try again.
auth.fillAllFields: Please fill in first name, last name, email and password.
auth.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.popupIncompleteBody: Please enter your first name, last name, email address and password to continue.
auth.popupPasswordBody: Your password must be at least 6 characters long. Please choose a longer one.
auth.popupEmailExistsBody: An account is already linked to this email. Sign in or use a different email address.
auth.popupLoginIncompleteBody: Please enter your email address and password.
